name: elysium-mainnet-drops
_why: Cloak v2's NFT drop contracts on mainnet: sealed NFT drops, WL spot sales and escrow drops, on v2's mainnet CloakConfig (drop fees to the treasury). None of them has an owner or admin.
_factoryRecord: v2's mainnet CloakConfig is read from the factory record (deploy-v2-factory.mjs writes it).
_defaultBaseURI: Metadata for drops that set none: the site's /api/nft route on the mainnet address.
_deployer: The mainnet deployer (docs/WALLETS.md). It gets no role: none of the three contracts has an owner.
